This page highlights my first-author research projects and selected collaborative work, along with key academic milestones.
For a complete list of publications and contributions, see my [Publications](../Publications/publications-page.qmd) or [CV](../cv/cv-page.qmd).

```{r tl-projects, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)

projects <- read.xlsx("projects.xlsx")

month_abb <- c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun",
               "Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")

esc <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || is.na(x)) return("")
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

slugify <- function(x) {
  tolower(gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]+", "-", trimws(as.character(x))))
}

laurel_left <- '<svg class="tl-laurel" viewBox="0 0 20 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M15.5 22.5 C12.5 21.3, 10.2 19.2, 8.8 16.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M12.2 20.5 C8.8 20.5, 6.2 19.2, 5.8 17 C8.5 16.8, 11 18.2, 12.2 20.5 Z"/><path d="M10.5 17.5 C9.8 15.2, 10.4 13.5, 11.8 12.6 C12.2 14.8, 11.6 16.5, 10.5 17.5 Z"/><path d="M8.2 15.8 C5 15, 3 13, 3.2 10.6 C5.8 11, 7.8 13, 8.2 15.8 Z"/><path d="M9 12.5 C8.5 9.8, 9.5 8, 11.2 7.2 C11.4 9.5, 10.5 11.5, 9 12.5 Z"/><path d="M7.5 10.5 C4.8 9, 3.8 6.5, 4.5 4.2 C7 5, 8.2 7.5, 7.5 10.5 Z"/><path d="M9.5 6.5 C9 3.8, 10.2 2, 12.5 1.5 C12.5 4, 11.2 5.8, 9.5 6.5 Z"/></svg>'
laurel_right <- '<svg class="tl-laurel" viewBox="0 0 20 24" aria-hidden="true"><g transform="translate(20,0) scale(-1,1)"><path d="M15.5 22.5 C12.5 21.3, 10.2 19.2, 8.8 16.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M12.2 20.5 C8.8 20.5, 6.2 19.2, 5.8 17 C8.5 16.8, 11 18.2, 12.2 20.5 Z"/><path d="M10.5 17.5 C9.8 15.2, 10.4 13.5, 11.8 12.6 C12.2 14.8, 11.6 16.5, 10.5 17.5 Z"/><path d="M8.2 15.8 C5 15, 3 13, 3.2 10.6 C5.8 11, 7.8 13, 8.2 15.8 Z"/><path d="M9 12.5 C8.5 9.8, 9.5 8, 11.2 7.2 C11.4 9.5, 10.5 11.5, 9 12.5 Z"/><path d="M7.5 10.5 C4.8 9, 3.8 6.5, 4.5 4.2 C7 5, 8.2 7.5, 7.5 10.5 Z"/><path d="M9.5 6.5 C9 3.8, 10.2 2, 12.5 1.5 C12.5 4, 11.2 5.8, 9.5 6.5 Z"/></g></svg>'

# Split into Milestones & Honours vs. Research Projects
is_honour <- !is.na(projects$Category) & projects$Category %in% c("Milestone", "Award")
honours <- projects[is_honour, , drop = FALSE] |>
  mutate(m_sort = ifelse(is.na(Month), -1L, as.integer(Month))) |>
  arrange(-Year, -m_sort)

research <- projects[!is_honour, , drop = FALSE] |>
  mutate(m_sort = ifelse(is.na(Month), -1L, as.integer(Month))) |>
  arrange(-Year, -m_sort)

# ── 1. Milestones & Honours Strip ────────────────────────────────────────────
honour_cards <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(honours)), function(i) {
  row <- as.list(honours[i, ])
  is_ms <- identical(row$Category, "Milestone") ||
    (!is.na(row$Title) && grepl("phd|defend|milestone", row$Title, ignore.case = TRUE))

  card_cls <- if (is_ms) "proj-honour-card proj-honour-milestone" else "proj-honour-card proj-honour-award"
  mon <- if (!is.na(row$Month)) month_abb[as.integer(row$Month)] else ""
  date_lbl <- trimws(paste(mon, row$Year))

  title_html <- if (!is.na(row$Link_1) && nzchar(trimws(row$Link_1))) {
    sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>', esc(trimws(row$Link_1)), esc(row$Title))
  } else {
    esc(row$Title)
  }

  venue_html <- if (!is.na(row$Venue) && nzchar(trimws(row$Venue))) {
    sprintf('<div class="proj-honour-venue">%s</div>', esc(row$Venue))
  } else ""

  note_html <- if (!is.na(row$Summary) && nzchar(trimws(row$Summary))) {
    sprintf('<div class="proj-honour-note">%s</div>', esc(row$Summary))
  } else ""

  link_tags <- ""
  for (k in 1:3) {
    nm  <- row[[paste0("Link_", k, "_name")]]
    url <- row[[paste0("Link_", k)]]
    if (!is.na(nm) && !is.na(url) && nzchar(trimws(url))) {
      if (is_ms) {
        link_tags <- paste0(link_tags, sprintf(
          '<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="proj-laurel-pill">%s%s%s</a>',
          esc(trimws(url)), laurel_left, esc(nm), laurel_right
        ))
      } else {
        link_tags <- paste0(link_tags, sprintf(
          '<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="proj-award-pill">%s</a>',
          esc(trimws(url)), esc(nm)
        ))
      }
    }
  }
  links_html <- if (nzchar(link_tags)) sprintf('<div class="proj-honour-links">%s</div>', link_tags) else ""

  sprintf(
'<div class="%s">
<div class="proj-honour-date">%s</div>
<div class="proj-honour-title">%s</div>
%s
%s
%s
</div>',
    card_cls, esc(date_lbl), title_html, venue_html, note_html, links_html
  )
}, character(1))

# ── 2. Research Projects Bento Grid ──────────────────────────────────────────
n_all  <- nrow(research)
n_meth <- sum(research$Category == "Methodology", na.rm = TRUE)
n_util <- sum(research$Category == "Clinical Utility", na.rm = TRUE)
n_ov   <- sum(research$Category == "Ovarian Cancer", na.rm = TRUE)
n_pre  <- sum(research$Status %in% c("Preprint", "Upcoming"), na.rm = TRUE)

research_cards <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(research)), function(i) {
  row <- as.list(research[i, ])
  cat_name <- if (!is.na(row$Category) && nzchar(row$Category)) row$Category else "Methodology"
  cat_slug <- slugify(cat_name)

  status_name <- if (!is.na(row$Status) && nzchar(row$Status)) {
    row$Status
  } else if (is.na(row$Link_1)) {
    "Upcoming"
  } else {
    "Published"
  }
  status_slug <- slugify(status_name)
  is_upcoming <- identical(status_slug, "upcoming") || is.na(row$Link_1)

  mon <- if (!is.na(row$Month)) month_abb[as.integer(row$Month)] else ""
  date_lbl <- trimws(paste(mon, row$Year))

  title_html <- if (!is.na(row$Link_1) && nzchar(trimws(row$Link_1))) {
    sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>', esc(trimws(row$Link_1)), esc(row$Title))
  } else {
    esc(row$Title)
  }

  venue_html <- if (!is.na(row$Venue) && nzchar(trimws(row$Venue))) {
    sprintf('<div class="proj-card-venue">%s</div>', esc(row$Venue))
  } else ""

  summary_html <- ""
  if (!is.na(row$Summary) && nzchar(trimws(row$Summary))) {
    summary_html <- sprintf(
      '<div class="proj-card-summary">%s</div>\n<button type="button" class="proj-expand-btn" onclick="toggleCardSummary(this)">Read more &#9656;</button>',
      esc(trimws(row$Summary))
    )
  }

  link_tags <- ""
  for (k in 1:3) {
    nm  <- row[[paste0("Link_", k, "_name")]]
    url <- row[[paste0("Link_", k)]]
    if (!is.na(nm) && !is.na(url) && nzchar(trimws(url))) {
      link_tags <- paste0(link_tags, sprintf(
        '<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="proj-link-btn">%s</a>',
        esc(trimws(url)), esc(nm)
      ))
    }
  }
  links_html <- if (nzchar(link_tags)) sprintf('<div class="proj-card-links">%s</div>', link_tags) else ""

  card_cls <- paste0("proj-card", if (is_upcoming) " proj-card-upcoming" else "")

  sprintf(
'<div class="%s" data-category="%s" data-status="%s">
<div class="proj-card-top">
<div class="proj-badges">
<span class="proj-cat-badge proj-cat-%s">%s</span>
<span class="proj-status-badge proj-status-%s">%s</span>
</div>
<span class="proj-card-date">%s</span>
</div>
<div class="proj-card-title">%s</div>
%s
%s
%s
</div>',
    card_cls, esc(cat_slug), esc(status_slug),
    esc(cat_slug), esc(cat_name),
    esc(status_slug), esc(status_name),
    esc(date_lbl), title_html, venue_html, summary_html, links_html
  )
}, character(1))

cat('<div class="column-body-outset">\n')
cat('<h2 class="proj-section-heading">Milestones &amp; Honours</h2>\n')
cat('<div class="proj-honours-grid">\n', paste(honour_cards, collapse = "\n"), '\n</div>\n')
cat('<h2 class="proj-section-heading">Research Projects</h2>\n')
cat(sprintf(
'<div class="proj-filter-bar" role="group" aria-label="Filter research projects">
<button type="button" class="proj-filter-btn active" onclick="filterProjects(\'all\', this)">All <span class="proj-filter-count">(%d)</span></button>
<button type="button" class="proj-filter-btn" onclick="filterProjects(\'methodology\', this)">Methodology <span class="proj-filter-count">(%d)</span></button>
<button type="button" class="proj-filter-btn" onclick="filterProjects(\'clinical-utility\', this)">Clinical Utility <span class="proj-filter-count">(%d)</span></button>
<button type="button" class="proj-filter-btn" onclick="filterProjects(\'ovarian-cancer\', this)">Ovarian Cancer <span class="proj-filter-count">(%d)</span></button>
<button type="button" class="proj-filter-btn" onclick="filterProjects(\'preprint-upcoming\', this)">Preprints &amp; Upcoming <span class="proj-filter-count">(%d)</span></button>
</div>\n',
  n_all, n_meth, n_util, n_ov, n_pre
))
cat('<div class="proj-grid">\n', paste(research_cards, collapse = "\n"), '\n</div>\n')
cat('</div>\n')
cat('<script>
function toggleCardSummary(btn) {
  const summary = btn.previousElementSibling;
  if (!summary) return;
  const expanded = summary.classList.toggle("expanded");
  btn.innerHTML = expanded ? "Show less &#9662;" : "Read more &#9656;";
}
function updateExpandButtons() {
  document.querySelectorAll(".proj-card").forEach(card => {
    if (card.style.display === "none") return;
    const summary = card.querySelector(".proj-card-summary");
    const btn = card.querySelector(".proj-expand-btn");
    if (!summary || !btn) return;
    if (summary.classList.contains("expanded")) {
      btn.style.display = "inline-block";
    } else {
      btn.style.display = (summary.scrollHeight > summary.clientHeight + 2) ? "inline-block" : "none";
    }
  });
}
function filterProjects(filterKey, btn) {
  document.querySelectorAll(".proj-filter-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
  if (btn) btn.classList.add("active");
  document.querySelectorAll(".proj-card").forEach(card => {
    const cat = card.getAttribute("data-category");
    const status = card.getAttribute("data-status");
    const show = (filterKey === "all") ||
      (filterKey === "preprint-upcoming" && (status === "preprint" || status === "upcoming")) ||
      (cat === filterKey);
    card.style.display = show ? "" : "none";
  });
  updateExpandButtons();
}
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", updateExpandButtons);
window.addEventListener("resize", updateExpandButtons);
</script>\n')
```
